bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
command -v gh >/dev/null || exit 62
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gaybbs-link62-compare.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/base" "$tmp/target"
gh run download 44583321273 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/base" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
gh run download 44753258961 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/target" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
test -s "$tmp/live.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/target/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 66
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp/target:/candidate:ro" --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --check /candidate/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 67
if ! cmp -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs"; then echo LINK_ONLY_BASELINE_MISMATCH=YES; exit 71; fi
echo LINK_ONLY_BASELINE_MATCH=PASS
echo OFFLINE_ARTIFACT=PASS
echo CURRENT_PRODUCTION_UNCHANGED=PASS
